models.summary: Anthropic 于 2026-09-22 发布的 Claude 5.5 家族第一款模型（官方页标题 “Introducing Claude Opus 5.5”，HTTP 200）。官方页正文称：它在多数工作上达到 Claude Fable 5.1 的水平，按典型负载跑起来比 Opus 5 少 40% 花费；meta description 称它在 agentic coding 与知识工作上领先，且比 Opus 5 少 40% 运行成本。官方价目（每百万 token）：输入 $4、输出 $20（称比 Opus 5 少 20%），cache reads $0.20（对照 Opus 5 的 $0.50，称少 60%），cache writes $5（对照 $6.25）；fast mode 为输入 $8 / 输出 $40，称最高 2.5 倍速度。第三方榜：Artificial Analysis 页面（变体 “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”）列出 Intelligence Index 58（#1 / 211）、输入 $4.00 / 输出 $20.00、缓存折扣 95%、每任务 $5.98、1M 上下文；速度栏为 N/A。HN：item 49803892（Algolia 核对 1793pts，2026-09-22 ~16:29Z）。
models.summaryEn: Anthropic’s first model in the Claude 5.5 family, announced 2026-09-22 (official page title “Introducing Claude Opus 5.5”, HTTP 200). The page says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads; the meta description says it leads in agentic coding and knowledge work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5. Vendor price table (per 1M tokens): input $4, output $20 (claimed 20% less than Opus 5), cache reads $0.20 (vs Opus 5 at $0.50, claimed 60% less), cache writes $5 (vs $6.25); fast mode is $8 input / $40 output, claimed up to 2.5× speed. Third-party board: the Artificial Analysis page (variant “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”) lists Intelligence Index 58 (#1 / 211), $4.00 input / $20.00 output, a 95% cache discount, $5.98 per task, and a 1M context; the speed cell is N/A. HN: item 49803892 (1793pts on Algolia at check time, 2026-09-22 ~16:29Z).

highlights.text: 官方称：Claude 5.5 家族第一款；正文写多数工作达到 Fable 5.1 水平，典型负载比 Opus 5 少 40% 花费，输出比 Opus 5 快 30% 以上。同页又称 Sonnet 5.5 与 Haiku 5.5 将在随后数周推出。平台模型 id 写作 claude-opus-5-5，并称已在全平台可用，包括 Amazon Web Services、Google Cloud 与 Microsoft Azure。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim: first model in the Claude 5.5 family; the page says it matches Fable 5.1 on most work, costs 40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads, and generates output more than 30% faster than Opus 5. The same page says Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 follow in the coming weeks. The platform model id is written claude-opus-5-5, and the page says it is available on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

highlights.text: 官方称（价目表，每百万 token）：cache reads $0.20（Opus 5 为 $0.50）、输入 $4（Opus 5 为 $5）、输出 $20（Opus 5 为 $25）、cache writes $5（Opus 5 为 $6.25）。页面另写输入/输出比 Opus 5 少 20%，cache reads 少 60%；fast mode（Claude Code 与 Claude Platform）最高 2.5 倍速度，输入 $8 / 输出 $40。本库未实测 API。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim (price table, per 1M tokens): cache reads $0.20 (Opus 5 $0.50), input $4 (Opus 5 $5), output $20 (Opus 5 $25), cache writes $5 (Opus 5 $6.25). The page also says input/output are 20% less than Opus 5 and cache reads are 60% less; fast mode (Claude Code and the Claude Platform) is up to 2.5× speed at $8 input / $40 output. API not tested here.

highlights.text: 官方称（对照表，列序 Opus 5.5 / Fable 5.1 / Opus 5 / GPT-6 Astra / GPT-5.6 Sol；页注除另有说明外 Opus 5.5 为 adaptive thinking、max effort；Terminal-Bench 4.0 的 Opus 5.5 为 xhigh、GPT-6 Astra 为 high，且为 OpenAI 所报）：Terminal-Bench 4.0 66.4% / 55.8% / 52.3% / 57.9% / 37.3%；FrontierCode v1.1 (Main) 54.4% / 50.3% / 48.0% / 53.3% / 47.5%。同表另有 Astra 更高的行：Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 为 64.6% 对 Opus 5.5 的 58.7%；AutomationBench（页注由 Zapier 跑）为 41.4% 对 40.0%。页面自己也写：与 Fable 5.1 的实际差距比这些分数看起来更窄。本库未复跑。
highlights.textEn: Vendor claim (comparison table, columns Opus 5.5 / Fable 5.1 / Opus 5 / GPT-6 Astra / GPT-5.6 Sol; the page says Opus 5.5 results use adaptive thinking at max effort unless noted; Terminal-Bench 4.0 is xhigh for Opus 5.5 and high for GPT-6 Astra, the latter as reported by OpenAI): Terminal-Bench 4.0 66.4% / 55.8% / 52.3% / 57.9% / 37.3%; FrontierCode v1.1 (Main) 54.4% / 50.3% / 48.0% / 53.3% / 47.5%. The same table has rows where Astra is ahead: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 is 64.6% vs Opus 5.5 at 58.7%; AutomationBench (page note: run by Zapier) is 41.4% vs 40.0%. The page itself also says the real gap versus Fable 5.1 is narrower than these scores suggest. None re-run here.

highlights.text: 第三方榜（Artificial Analysis，非官方、非本库）：页面标题为 “Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback)”，变体 “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”；Intelligence Index 58（#1 / 211），速度 Output tokens per second 为 N/A，价格输入 $4.00 / 输出 $20.00、Cache Discount 95%、Cost per Intelligence Index task $5.98，Verbosity 260M output tokens（#96 / 211）。技术规格写推理版、输入 text and image、输出 text、上下文 1M。发布月记为 September 2026。不把 AA 的 95% 缓存折扣与官方 $0.20 cache reads 合成新指标。
highlights.textEn: Third-party board (Artificial Analysis — neither vendor nor this library): page title “Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback)”, variant “Adaptive Reasoning, Max Effort, Default Fallback”; Intelligence Index 58 (#1 / 211); output tokens per second is N/A; pricing $4.00 input / $20.00 output, Cache Discount 95%, $5.98 cost per Intelligence Index task; verbosity 260M output tokens (#96 / 211). Specs list a reasoning version, text and image input, text output, and a 1M context. Release month is written September 2026. The AA 95% cache discount is not merged here with the vendor’s $0.20 cache-read price into a new figure.

highlights.text: 作者称：非自回归、基于双向编码器的 System 1 决策模型，单次前向对任意状态（文本、邮件、工单、JSON）输出结构化决策与校准概率，不生成文本。
highlights.textEn: Author claim: a non-autoregressive System 1 decision model built on bidirectional encoders; one forward pass over any state (text, email, ticket, JSON) returns structured decisions with calibrated probabilities — no text generation.

highlights.text: 作者称：三类原语 — choice（从候选字典选一项，返回选项、分布与置信度）、score（按序数评分表定级）、noul（布尔问题，返回校准的 P(true)）。
highlights.textEn: Author claim: three primitives — choice (pick one key from a criteria dictionary, with distribution and confidence), score (place the state on an ordinal rubric), and noul (a boolean question returning calibrated P(true)).

highlights.text: 作者称：单 GPU 约 32.8ms（亚 35ms），多语路由覆盖 100+ 语言，权重 Apache 2.0 开源、可自托管；页面自述「6–8 倍快于 Jev」及多项对比表数字，本库未复跑。
highlights.textEn: Author claim: about 32.8ms on a single GPU (sub-35ms), multilingual routing across 100+ languages, Apache 2.0 open weights, self-hostable; the page’s “6–8× faster than Jev” and comparison-table figures are author claims not re-run here.

highlights.text: 作者自述局限：choice 选项超过 20 个时表现下降；开箱基础模型在 typed-decisions 基准上接近随机，公布分数来自在基准训练集上微调后的结果（作者原文如此）。
highlights.textEn: Author-stated limits: choice degrades beyond ~20 options; out-of-the-box base models score near random on the typed-decisions benchmark, and the published score comes after fine-tuning on that benchmark’s train split (per the author).
